title: Realtime Fraud Detector

panels.title: Synthetic precision
panels.description: Cumulative acknowledged simulator oracle labels, grouped by model. Labels here are known immediately for evaluation only; model feedback is delayed seven simulated days. No denominator means no value. Scenarios: 1 unusual purchase, 2 compromised terminal, 3 spending burst. Requires the running simulator; disabled simulations show no current data.
